title: Visual explanation
when: Showing how or why something works on any subject: a relationship between two quantities, small amounts adding up, noisy evidence settling into an estimate, where things flow. For curious viewers who want the idea, not a summary
rules: Intuition before symbols: show the picture change, then name it.
One idea changes at a time; everything else holds still.
A colour means one thing for the whole film (the input, the total, the estimate).
Keep the same object in the same place across beats so the eye can follow it.
Hold after each change long enough to see what it did.
Cue every move to the word that names it.
